strategy.thesis: EU's central fund-of-funds and limited partner — Europe's biggest LP — channeling EU and EIB capital into venture capital, private equity, private debt and guarantees via financial intermediaries to support SMEs and scale-ups.

It anchors flagship fund-of-funds programmes such as the European Tech Champions Initiative.

It invests directly in early-stage Irish companies and anchors private funds via the Seed and Venture Capital Scheme, whose 2025–2029 cycle has a record €250m allocation.

strategy.thesis: Portugal's state-backed venture capital firm, part of the Banco Português de Fomento group, investing in pre-seed, seed and Series A startups with internationally scalable solutions in digital, engineering & industry, life sciences and tourism.

summary.en: Portugal Ventures is Portugal's state-backed venture capital firm, founded in 2012 (from a merger of three public VC companies) and part of the Banco Português de Fomento group. It manages around €182m across more than 130 portfolio companies, investing at pre-seed, seed and Series A.
summary.local: A Portugal Ventures é a sociedade de capital de risco do Estado português, fundada em 2012 e integrada no grupo Banco Português de Fomento, gerindo cerca de 182 milhões de euros em mais de 130 empresas.
